an6.115:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an6.115:1.7: dovacassatāya pahānāya sovacassatā bhāvetabbā pāpamittatāya pahānāya kalyāṇamittatā bhāvetabbā. cetaso vikkhepassa pahānāya ānāpānasati bhāvetabbā.
an6.115:1.8: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
